library.rt_240:r_e6a09058a5eb3fd3.text:
A Mechanical Angel that Apollonius created 24,000 years ago to fight the $$堕天翅$$. Also called the Mythical-type Aquarion.
It can transform into three different configurations by combining its three Vector Machines, and the order in which they combine drastically changes the completed form's abilities.
$$ソーラーアクエリオン$$ is formed with Vector Sol as the upper body, Vector Mars as the lower body, and Vector Ruuna as the back unit.
It is characterized by a red-based color scheme and a head modeled on the sun, and its shoulders and shins are fitted with power stones that amplify bio-energy and higher-dimensional quantum power.
At the end of the battle 12,000 years ago, it became a living sacrifice to save the world from collapse and fell asleep, but it reawakened in response to the clash between $$アマタ$$ and $$カグラ$$, appearing before the two of them in a form of shining gold.

library.rt_240:r_bd0f04425e3bf002.text:
The Mythical-type Aquarion, transformed by $$ミカゲ$$'s hatred.
$$ミカゲ$$ completed it by taking over $$ゼシカ$$'s body, trampling $$カグラ$$'s spirit, forcibly drawing in Vector Ruuna as piloted by $$ミコノ$$, and thereby consummating a 'wedding of revenge.'
Having absorbed all of Altair's energy and evolved, its new form lacks the divine grace of the old Mythical-type Aquarion; instead it radiates an ominous aura that seems to be a projection of $$ミカゲ$$'s own heart, and boasts a size beyond comparison with any other Aquarion.
Its finishing move, 'Shinrai Mugen Shou (Infinite Palm of the Buddha),' is a technique that reverses cause and effect: the 'result' of an action manifests first, and only afterward is the Infinite Palm unleashed as its 'cause.'

library.rt_240:r_6a9077ecde1547df.text:
A prototype of the $$ＤＥＭ$$ (Dimension Energy Machinery) series, a line of dimensional-power-use mobile weapons developed by $$ＤＥＭ$$ Corporation. Its model number is $$ＤＥＭ$$-03.
It was caught in a dimensional quake during testing and descended to Earth together with $$ＡＧ$$, an agent robot of $$ＤＥＭ$$ Corporation.
It was developed with an emphasis on the first stage of dimensional power use, as a power source, aiming to be the ultimate general-purpose unit able to perform at its best in any environment.
It is equipped with the tactical system and next-generation dimensional power control mechanism 'TS-DEMON,' along with a variety of weaponry suited to any combat range and the 'D-Fault' defense mechanism that makes use of dimensional faults, resulting in a unit with a good balance of offense and defense.
It currently takes part in actual combat under $$ＡＧ$$'s supervision, doubling as a means of data collection.

library.rt_240:r_49138cf6e6a1ee52.text:
A prototype of the $$ＤＥＭ$$ (Dimension Energy Machinery) series, a line of dimensional-power-use mobile weapons developed by $$ＤＥＭ$$ Corporation. Its model number is $$ＤＥＭ$$-03.
It was caught in a dimensional quake during testing and descended to Earth together with $$ＡＧ$$, an agent robot of $$ＤＥＭ$$ Corporation.
It was originally single-seat, but a seat for a navigator was installed, converting it to a two-seater.
It was developed with an emphasis on the first stage of dimensional power use, as a power source, aiming to be the ultimate general-purpose unit able to perform at its best in any environment.
It is equipped with the tactical system and next-generation dimensional power control mechanism 'TS-DEMON,' along with a variety of weaponry suited to any combat range and the 'D-Fault' defense mechanism that makes use of dimensional faults, resulting in a unit with a good balance of offense and defense.
It also has a transformation mechanism into the aggressive 'GAI Mode,' which reflects the pilot's mental state. Even $$ＡＧ$$ had not been informed of this function, but as data was gathered through battle, the conditions for its activation were gradually worked out.

library.rt_240:r_9ae885dc961c01b8.text:
The form $$ジェニオン$$ takes when it activates 'GAI Mode.'
'GAI' stands for 'Glitter Armament Infinity,' a name given by $$ＡＧ$$.
Its existence was not known even to the agent $$ＡＧ$$, and its first activation came about almost by accident.
The pilot's mental state is involved in triggering it. This is thought to be because $$ジェニオン$$'s 'TS-DEMON' must shift into what could be called a second stage, a mode that goes beyond simple control of dimensional power to sense the pilot's emotions and will, and draw out dimensional power through them.
Unlike $$ジェニオン$$, which only used dimensional power as a power source, GAI Mode actively diverts dimensional power's greatest characteristic, phenomenon control, into its weaponry. As a result, its combat strength surpasses $$ジェニオン$$'s, boasting overwhelming destructive power.
Its drawback is that the dimensional power drawn out by the second-stage TS-DEMON has a quantitative limit; as things stand, this form can only be maintained for about one to two minutes.

library.rt_240:r_8077e678d2f222ee.text:
The form $$ジェニオン$$ takes when it activates 'GAI Mode.'
'GAI' stands for 'Glitter Armament Infinity,' a name given by $$ＡＧ$$.
Its existence was not known even to the agent $$ＡＧ$$, and its first activation came about almost by accident.
The pilot's mental state is involved in triggering it. This is thought to be because $$ジェニオン$$'s 'TS-DEMON' must shift into what could be called a second stage, a mode that goes beyond simple control of dimensional power to sense the pilot's emotions and will, and draw out dimensional power through them.
Unlike $$ジェニオン$$, which only used dimensional power as a power source, GAI Mode actively diverts dimensional power's greatest characteristic, phenomenon control, into its weaponry. As a result, its combat strength surpasses $$ジェニオン$$'s, boasting overwhelming destructive power.
Its appearance closely resembles that of $$ジェミニア$$, developed on Planet Gemini, suggesting some connection between the two. $$ＡＧ$$ described this as a deliberate case of convergent evolution (the phenomenon whereby things sharing similar properties also come to resemble each other in form) aimed at seizing the $$スフィア$$ of the Quarreling Twins. The fact that a $$スフィア$$ was seized at all, something thought only possible between $$スフィア$$ Reactors, is itself strong evidence that the seizure of the Quarreling Twins' $$スフィア$$ was this unit's very purpose in being developed.
At first, the dimensional power drawn out by the second-stage TS-DEMON had a quantitative limit, and this form could be maintained for only about one to two minutes. However, once the $$スフィア$$ of the Quarreling Twins was seized from $$ジェミニア$$, this problem was resolved. Furthermore, thanks to the pilot's qualities as a Reactor, TS-DEMON was able to control the $$スフィア$$, raising the unit's combat strength beyond what it had ever been.

library.rt_240:r_6e508ad8ab7f3854.text:
A mobile weapon piloted by $$ガドライト$$.
It carries the $$スフィア$$ of the Quarreling Twins.
It was developed for $$ガドライト$$, the strongest pilot on Planet Gemini, and brings together Gemini's finest technology.
Its base design follows on from $$ディオスク$$, sharing the same psychokinetic control interface, light-particle-based weaponry, and high melee performance. However, combining these with $$ガドライト$$'s powerful psychokinetic ability, his outstanding piloting skill, and the $$スフィア$$'s dimensional power produces overwhelming combat strength. By calculation, its fighting power is equal to a whole battalion of $$ディオスク$$ units.
To the Geminids, it is a symbol of their homeworld's prosperity and has become something more than a mere mobile weapon, which is why the Geminiss hate $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$, whose appearance closely resembles it.

library.rt_240:r_19cdd628f02cecbe.text:
A mobile weapon piloted by $$ガドライト$$.
It carries the $$スフィア$$ of the Quarreling Twins.
It was developed for $$ガドライト$$, the strongest pilot on Planet Gemini, and brings together Gemini's finest technology. The $$スフィア$$ fitted to it at that time was still under analysis at first, but once $$ガドライト$$ awakened as a Reactor, its various functions were unraveled and $$ジェミニア$$ was completed.
Its base design follows on from $$ディオスク$$, sharing the same psychokinetic control interface, light-particle-based weaponry, and high melee performance. However, combining these with $$ガドライト$$'s powerful psychokinetic ability, his outstanding piloting skill, and the $$スフィア$$'s dimensional power produces overwhelming combat strength. By calculation, its fighting power is equal to a whole battalion of $$ディオスク$$ units.
The $$スフィア$$'s control over phenomena is focused entirely on improving this unit's mobility and agility and landing a decisive blow on the enemy, giving it a plainer impression than other $$スフィア$$-equipped units. However, everything about it is unified around the single concept of delivering one finishing blow, producing overwhelming offensive power that surpasses even other $$スフィア$$-equipped units.
To the Geminids, it is a symbol of their homeworld's prosperity and has become something more than a mere mobile weapon, which is why the Geminiss hate $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$, whose appearance closely resembles it.
Together with the Geminiss, it remained undefeated, but a single loss brought about the day Planet Gemini fell to ruin.
In the decisive battle after the $$時空修復$$, the $$スフィア$$ of the Quarreling Twins was seized from it by $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$, and it was defeated.

library.rt_240:r_8d9534652f063e83.text:
A mass-produced mobile weapon used by the Geminiss.
A weapon developed on Planet Gemini, this high-grade unit was issued on a priority basis to the Geminiss, the elite corps.
Version A is the commander's model, piloted by $$アンナロッタ$$.
It employs a man-machine interface called psychokinetic control, through which a Geminiss member's psychokinetic power is applied directly to piloting. Because of this, each unit is finely tuned to match its pilot.
By using its various weapons, which draw on light particles extracted through dimensional power, with the high responsiveness and mobility afforded by psychokinetic control, it possesses tremendous melee ability. In particular, 'Command Arts,' which reproduces Gemini's traditional martial arts through the unit itself, is extremely effective in mobile weapon combat, and $$ディオスク$$, which puts it into practice, stood alongside $$ジェミニア$$ as a symbol of strength to the Geminids.

library.rt_240:r_891cf066ad18ec0e.text:
An $$アンゲロイ$$ led by $$尸空$$ of the Sidereal.
It is a different color version of the $$アンゲロイ$$ used by the Geminiss, but shows no difference in performance.
This suggests that the type serves as the Sidereal's basic combat strength, with its coloring varying by the unit it belongs to.

library.rt_240:r_c8a63848b1c38e46.text:
A mass-produced mobile weapon used by the Geminiss.
The unit is built with flexible armor plating covering a movable frame. This armor is fitted with a mechanism for releasing energy to the outside, and can transform as needed to be used as a weapon as well.
It boasts high mobility that makes the most of its frame structure and high-output weaponry, giving it combat strength that sets it apart from weapons of Earth manufacture.

library.rt_240:r_0cb2378a6f68f95b.text:
A mass-produced mobile weapon used by the Geminiss.
The unit is built with flexible armor plating covering a movable frame. This armor is fitted with a mechanism for releasing energy to the outside, and can transform as needed to be used as a weapon as well.
It boasts high mobility that makes the most of its frame structure and high-output weaponry, giving it combat strength that sets it apart from weapons of Earth manufacture.
It seems that each unit within the Sidereal owns its own color of $$アンゲロイ$$, and this coloring is thought to be the version used by the Geminiss.

library.rt_240:r_643b067d6e6d6a8a.text:
A mass-produced mobile weapon used by the Geminiss.
It is basically unmanned, controlled by an AI.
At first glance it looks frail, but thanks to its simple structure and a design that gives no consideration whatsoever to pilot safety, it can shrug off a fair amount of damage, giving it high durability.
Its offensive power is inferior to the $$アンゲロイ$$'s, but combined with the durability described above and tactics based on numbers, it becomes a considerable threat.

library.rt_240:r_f73d9575b3b074ad.text:
A mass-produced mobile weapon used by the Sidereal.
It is basically unmanned, controlled by an AI.

Unlike the $$アンゲロイ$$, no difference in coloring is seen between units.

library.rt_240:r_c1baead826d24ce4.text:
A mobile weapon piloted by $$尸空$$; its name is read '$$尸逝天$$.'
It carries the $$スフィア$$ of the 'Silent Giant Crab' and has an appearance reminiscent of the corpse of a huge creature.
It possesses high firepower and can attack multiple targets simultaneously.

library.rt_240:r_daeeb241da4c4210.text:
A mobile weapon piloted by $$尸空$$; its name is read '$$尸逝天$$.'
It carries the $$スフィア$$ of the 'Silent Giant Crab' and has an appearance reminiscent of the corpse of a huge creature.
It possesses high firepower and can attack multiple targets simultaneously.
Everything about it remains shrouded in mystery, and at present it does not appear to have unleashed the full extent of its power.

library.rt_240:r_a6e21ee335987c69.text:
A humanoid mobile weapon piloted by $$アドヴェント$$.
It has high mobility and a well-balanced arsenal, and combined with $$アドヴェント$$'s own piloting skill, it can bring its full strength to bear in any situation.
The circumstances of its development remain shrouded in mystery, but it is presumed that dimensional power is used in some form as its power source.
A mass-produced version also exists, and it too boasts high combat strength.

library.rt_240:r_ce5baf992250bd82.text:
A humanoid mobile weapon piloted by $$アドヴェント$$.
It has high mobility and a well-balanced arsenal, and combined with $$アドヴェント$$'s own piloting skill, it can bring its full strength to bear in any situation.
The circumstances of its development remain shrouded in mystery, but dimensional power is used in some form as its power source, and its output and control over phenomena are on a level comparable to $$スフィア$$-equipped units.
The Chrono Reform Faction uses a mass-produced version of this unit, and it too boasts high combat strength.

library.rt_240:r_4d281d91f1c95bb2.text:
A custom type of the Axio, a bestselling humanoid mobile weapon.
It is a special-duty model built through thorough weight reduction and enhanced stealth and communication performance, making it an extremely expensive machine.
It has been the favored unit of the special forces $$ファイヤバグ$$ since their days as military personnel, and it is equipped with the electromagnetic melee weapon 'EM Dagger.'
The base Axio unit was known for its excellent handling, but $$ファイヤバグ$$ has tuned this one further, giving it a touchy, high-strung feel to pilot. Put another way, the squad's members, who handle it as naturally as their own limbs, are capable of piloting any mobile weapon.
Incidentally, 'Burglar' means a thief, and when it was sold by the Axion Foundation it went by the name 'Night Bird.'
